messages.snippet: All, Delighted to confirm Project Solstice completed this morning. Ardent's £8,000,000 subscription
messages.subject: Project Solstice - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Delighted to confirm Project Solstice completed this morning. Ardent's £8,000,000 subscription monies were received; the 2,000,000 Series A Preferred Shares have been issued and the register updated. Daniel is appointed to the board. Executed Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement attached for your files.

Post-completion I'll file SH01, AP01 and the amended articles at Companies House within the statutory deadlines and circulate the updated cap table. Congratulations to everyone.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1190
